title: Membership in the Fourier support
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $S$ be a finite set of coordinates in $	ext{Fin}(n)$. Then $S$ belongs to the Fourier support of $f$ exactly when the Fourier coefficient of $f$ at $S$ is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: Real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube of dimension $n$
